sampling: Stratified by year, season, VIIRS recorded presence and latitude third. Fixed random seed.

review_protocol.status: Pilot thresholds requiring local expert review

imagery.qa_method: SCL 4 vegetation and 5 bare land; cloud/shadow/water/uncertain classes excluded
imagery.display: SWIR2 / NIR / red, fixed reflectance stretch 0–0.5
imagery.selection_rule: First two dry-season sample IDs within each year and latitude-third, without consulting detection counts
imagery.scene_selection: Earliest and latest distinct date inside month with >=90% SCL classes 4/5/6 over cell. Fallback to bracketing scenes within 30 days.
